A '''holotract''' was a literary work used to disseminate ideas, values, and messages to an audience. One known holotract was the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]]'s ''[[Those Who Drown]]'', which highlighted the plight of people living under Sith rule during the [[New Sith Wars]].
